notes: A start and finish read from the teleport graph (chk-maps run 85). Levels level1..level22 follow `start`; the last shaft drops past the thank-you lights to a 128x128 teleport to `end`, the finish. The f_1..f_7 teleports are the per-level fall floors that send by the name a level gives. Not published.

conditional_teleports.note: The anti-standing trap: touching a block renames the player `activator` after 0.09 s and back to `default` after 0.1 s; the teleports behind filter_activator fire only on that name. Run as sinking blocks.

zones.note: round the `start` destination (-6584 -15184 6968), reaching down to the floor about 240 units under it where the player lands
the single teleport to `end` at the foot of the final shaft
